Subject: Subprocessor coverage & proof for SOC2 intake

Hi Stephanie —

We're kicking off HealthBridge's SOC2 intake and we need a scoped set of artifacts centered on your runtime/subprocessor footprint. Specifically we need:

- An up-to-date subprocessor roster (name, role, region, residency of data processing)
- KMS custody/residency statement for any keys that could decrypt customer data (where keys live, who holds custody)
- A CAIQ-to-SIG mapping for controls where you claim equivalence (so our assessor can cross-reference)
- Copy of your most recent SOC2 (PDF) or a SOC2 letter if available

Can you confirm what you can provide by next Friday (Aug 21)? Ideally we get a CSV roster + a short evidence pack (PDF/zip) that we can drop into our portal.

Thanks — appreciate a point of contact for follow-ups.

Best,

HealthBridge
